name: Error with retry
summary: Says in plain words what failed and that nothing else broke, with an optional error code, a Try again button and one other way forward.
use: when a load, search or action failed and trying again may work
a11y: A section named by its heading; the icon is decorative, so the failure is said in words, and Try again is a real button that comes first in tab order.

use_when: something the person asked for failed (a load, a search, a payment that did not start) and trying again may work
avoid_when: the action went through, or was refused for a known reason: use receipt with the danger tone
a list loaded and is simply empty: use empty-state
a warning about something that has not failed yet: use approval-prompt

parts.name: title
parts.what: what failed, in a few words

parts.name: message
parts.what: what happened in plain words and what was not affected

parts.name: detail
parts.what: an optional error code or reference for support

empty.how: an error always says what failed; there is no empty version

loading.how: while a retry runs the button is disabled with a progress cursor

error.how: this component is the error state: an icon and a border in the danger colour, never a red block

disabled.how: a disabled button uses the disabled colours

overflow.how: the buttons wrap, and on a phone they stack at full width under the text

long_text.how: title, message and error code wrap, also long codes with no spaces

keyboard: Tab reaches Try again, then the other action
